claims.statement: N33Affine.exists_full_affine_family matches the affine approximation lemma in the pinned local OA149 affine source for m >= 1 and a < b: finite nonempty family, fixed cube slopes, every offset o(h^a), pointwise-only positivity of arbitrary E on cube slopes, unrestricted approximating sequences with only the limit in the cube, eventual weak all-label activity, and strict coordinatewise error below E at the selected slope.

h_n tends to zero through positive values
p_n tends to p and only p is required to lie in [a,b]^m

audit_scope.finite_glue_detail: Delegated to parallel auditor; only source-to-interface semantics inspected here.
failed_attacks: Tied minima do not defeat the conclusion because formal Active is weak comparison against every label.
A discontinuous tolerance with infimum zero is not an obstruction because the bad set uses fixed E values at finitely many selected slopes.
Outside-cube approximating vectors and closed-cube face limits are admitted by FullApproximation and ActiveLimit.
Negative exponents and nonmonotone scales remain covered after the sequence is eventually positive and below one.
The cases m=0 and a=b follow vacuously or from the singleton baseline branch.
